items.problem: UWP Application.Suspending/Resuming (SuspendingEventHandler/Args) copied verbatim don't exist on WinUI 3 Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application -> build fails; skill had no coverage and no inventory signal.
items.evidence: migration-score.json build_error 'Application.Suspending/Resuming not defined ... Scenario1_ConnectDisconnect.xaml.cs, EventHandlerForDevice.cs'; call sites in EventHandlerForDevice.cs / Scenario1 / Scenario4.
items.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md #lifecycle only covered OnLaunched/OnActivated; unsupported-api-inventory.json had no Suspending pattern, so Initialize injected no TODO and Validate flagged nothing.
items.change: Added an 'adaptable' inventory entry (pattern for SuspendingEventHandler/Args and .Suspending/.Resuming += / -=, anchor '#lifecycle', tier safe) so Initialize-UwpMigration injects a TODO at every call site; also extended the #lifecycle section of MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md with a 'Suspending / Resuming are gone' subsection (map cleanup to Window.Closed / AppWindow.Closing, no resume equivalent).
items.expected_effect: Every future migration surfaces suspend/resume sites as inline TODOs routed to the #lifecycle guidance, and the dev-agent has a concrete replacement, so the app compiles.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, Initialize injects '// TODO[migrate-NNN]: see PATTERNS.md#lifecycle' at each App.Current.Suspending/Resuming line and the build no longer emits 'Application does not contain a definition for Suspending/Resuming'.

items.problem: x:Bind/x:DataType compiled bindings fail (WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999) when the SDK-sample root namespace (SDKTemplate) is only partially reconciled with the scaffold project name.
items.evidence: migration-score.json build_error 'WMC0909 Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario ... WMC9999 internal compiler error in MainPage.xaml'; MainPage.xaml.cs/SampleConfiguration.cs=SDKTemplate vs Scenario*.cs=CustomUsbDeviceAccess.
items.root_cause: The x:Bind section only mentioned XLS0414/MC3074 from stale UWP prefixes; it did not warn that x:Bind resolves by CLR namespace and that a drifted/partially-renamed root namespace breaks compiled bindings.
items.change: Sharpened the existing '### x:Bind and compiled bindings' section: added WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 symptoms and the rule to keep C# namespace, x:Class, and xmlns:local='using:...' consistent project-wide (fix by unifying, not by deleting x:DataType).
items.expected_effect: Dev-agent keeps a single consistent root namespace, so DataTemplate x:Bind/x:DataType resolve and MainPage.xaml compiles.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, MainPage.xaml compiles with no WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 and the ListBox item template renders scenario titles.

deferred_to_human: Tier-0/harness: first net10.0 WinUI build is slow and emits noisy progress output; the dev-agent wasted turns 82-99 polling it. Consider a harness/preset build helper that redirects output to a file and returns only error/warning lines, or a larger turn budget for the build/fix loop.
